hospital_info.name: MetroCare General Hospital
hospital_info.overview: MetroCare General Hospital is a premier multispecialty healthcare institution committed to providing comprehensive, high-quality, patient-centered medical services with state-of-the-art facilities.
hospital_info.address: 123 Healthcare Boulevard, Medical District, Cityville, State 560001
hospital_info.location_landmarks: Opposite Central City Park, 5 minutes from Metro Central Station.

visiting_hours.icu_and_critical_care: 11:00 AM - 12:00 PM and 5:00 PM - 6:00 PM (Strictly one visitor at a time)
visiting_rules: Visitors must obtain a Visitor Pass from the main reception.
Children under 12 years are not permitted in ICU/IPD wards for safety reasons.
Sanitizing hands before and after entering patient rooms is mandatory.

emergency_services.facilities: Level-1 Trauma Center, 24/7 Cardiac Cath Lab, Dedicated Stroke Unit, Advanced ICU Ambulances
emergency_services.guidance: For life-threatening emergencies, proceed directly to Gate 2 or call our 24/7 Emergency Line at +1 (800) 555-9111.

departments.name: Cardiology & Vascular Sciences
departments.description: Comprehensive cardiac care including non-invasive cardiology, interventional cardiology, and cardiac rehabilitation.

departments.name: Neurology & Neurosurgery
departments.description: Advanced care for disorders of the brain, spinal cord, peripheral nerves, and stroke management.

departments.name: Orthopedics & Joint Replacement
departments.description: Specialized diagnosis and treatment of bone, joint, ligament, and muscle conditions.

departments.name: Pediatrics & Neonatology
departments.description: Dedicated healthcare for infants, children, and adolescents, including a Level-III NICU.

departments.name: General Medicine & Diabetology
departments.description: Primary healthcare, management of chronic illnesses like diabetes and hypertension, and preventive health checks.

facilities.name: 24/7 Pharmacy
facilities.description: In-house pharmacy providing prescription and over-the-counter medications round the clock.

facilities.name: Advanced Radiology & Diagnostic Center
facilities.description: 3T MRI, 128-Slice CT Scan, Digital X-Ray, Mammography, and Ultrasound.

facilities.name: NABL Accredited Clinical Laboratory
facilities.description: Automated blood, urine, pathology, and microbiology testing with quick online reporting.

facilities.name: Inpatient Wards & Deluxe Private Rooms
facilities.description: Includes Economy Wards, Semi-Private Rooms, Single Deluxe Rooms, and Executive Suites.

facilities.name: Cafeteria & Dietary Services
facilities.description: Hygienic vegetarian and non-vegetarian food options curated by clinical dietitians.

admission_guidelines.planned_admission: Visit the Admission Desk (Main Lobby) 2 hours prior to scheduled time with doctor's admission slip, photo ID, and insurance card.
admission_guidelines.emergency_admission: Handled directly through the Emergency Department triage desk with immediate medical stabilization prioritized.

insurance_and_billing.cashless_insurance: Empaneled with over 30 major insurance providers and TPAs. Contact the Insurance Desk at Block A, Ground Floor.
insurance_and_billing.payment_modes: Credit/Debit Cards, Net Banking, UPI, and Cash.
insurance_and_billing.billing_desk_timings: 24/7 for Emergency and Inpatient Discharges; 8:00 AM - 8:00 PM for Outpatient Billing.
